description: Tracks every product warranty you own and surfaces claims before they expire.
notes: Demo data only; claim checklists are guidance, not filed claims.
Built against the shared Kit contract (window.Kit); a minimal inline shim is retained as fallback if shared/kit.js is ever absent.

notes.note: Billions in warranty value expires unclaimed — true. But $4/mo for expiry alerts is a vitamin: nobody wakes up wanting warranty software, and the affiliate revenue from extended-warranty partners is the actual business wearing a subscription costume. Useful utility, weak company.

notes.change: header brand title was invisible (dark --ink on shared dark kit header); forced light header title/sub text
claim-button tab scroll put #main-tabs under the fixed header; added scroll-margin-top (plus light header title fix)

notes.note: Claim checklist flow verified (2 of 5 progress tracked); zero errors. Fixed header overlap.

notes.change: Live clock (frozen Oct-3 date made day-counters stale); claim checklist now ends in a real downloadable claim package (.txt); 'File before' date is dynamic from the product expiry; fixed pre-existing saveS crash (toISOString on string) that broke Add-product. u7->8.
